# Models

Which models the converters handle: 2784 models of 3 checks, from a case written for one feature of SBML to a published model of many components. Every model is simulated, converted to the other language, simulated again and compared, converted back and simulated once more; a model **works** when every one of these stages passes. The wall times of the simulations are on the [Benchmarks](benchmarks.md) page.

- [SBML test suite](testsuite.md): 1658 cases, the semantic cases of the [SBML test suite](https://github.com/sbmlteam/sbml-test-suite), small models written for one feature of SBML each, with the expected results of the suite
- [BioModels](biomodels.md): 1060 models, the manually curated SBML models of [BioModels](https://www.biomodels.org), published models of systems biology
- [Physiome Model Repository](physiome.md): 66 models, the CellML models of the [Physiome Model Repository](https://models.physiomeproject.org), published models of physiology, most of them of many components

A check whose source is the SBML model and one whose source is the CellML model name the stages differently, the role of a stage is the same:

| check | source simulated | converted | reproduces | converted back | roundtrip |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [SBML test suite](testsuite.md) | `sbmlsim` | `sbml2cellml` | `libopencor` | `cellml2sbml` | `roundtrip` |
| [BioModels](biomodels.md) | `sbmlsim` | `sbml2cellml` | `libopencor` | `cellml2sbml` | `roundtrip` |
| [Physiome Model Repository](physiome.md) | `libopencor` | `cellml2sbml` | `sbmlsim` | `sbml2cellml` | `roundtrip` |

## Overview

The share of the models which pass a stage, the models which pass every stage and the models which do not run at all, whose reason is in the report of the check.

| check | models | source simulated | converted | reproduces | converted back | roundtrip | works | skipped |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [SBML test suite](testsuite.md) | 1658 | 99.9% | 97.1% | 69.6% | 97.1% | 96.4% | 1154 (69.6%) | 165 |
| [BioModels](biomodels.md) | 1060 | 99.3% | 99.3% | 88.6% | 99.3% | 98.4% | 939 (88.6%) | 15 |
| [Physiome Model Repository](physiome.md) | 66 | 93.9% | 93.9% | 86.4% | 93.9% | 92.4% | 56 (84.8%) | 34 |
